outcome: Glycemic control (HbA1c, time in range (TIRp), time below range (TBRp), time above range (TARp), glucose variability (CV))
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women with type 1 diabetes (T1D) from Spain who used either the Minimed(tm) 780G or Minimed(tm) 640G insulin pump since before pregnancy.
finding: Pregestational use of the Minimed(tm) 780G system, despite initial improvements in TIRp, was associated with a significantly increased risk of large-for-gestational-age infants and macrosomia compared to Minimed(tm) 640G users.
mod_finding: Women using the Minimed(tm) 780G system pregestationally had a significantly higher likelihood of undergoing a cesarean section compared to those using the Minimed(tm) 640G system.
